column3: CA FAIR Plan will exceed 750K policies by end of 2026 as 2026 wildfire season reinforces carrier retreat and Sustainable Insurance Strategy proves insufficient to attract major private capacity
column9: 6+ major carriers publicly commit to CA with actual volume AND FAIR Plan begins sustained decline

column3: FL Citizens will remain below 400K policies through end of 2026 hurricane season, as 2026 forecast (below-normal, El Nino) does not trigger a reversal of the depopulation trend
column9: Major hurricane (Cat 3+) makes landfall in FL causing >$25B insured losses
column10: CSU/AccuWeather: below-normal 2026 season forecast. El Nino developing = wind shear dampening. Risk: it only takes one storm. Confidence is moderate — hurricane forecasting is uncertain.

column3: ACA marketplace enrollment will fall below 22M for 2027 plan year absent new subsidy legislation, as premium shock ($178/mo vs $113/mo prior) drives sustained enrollment decline
column9: Congress passes and signs ARP-equivalent enhanced premium subsidies before Nov 2026 OE
column10: First year (2026): 23.1M (-4.9%). Year 2 effect = consumers who stayed in 2026 face another renewal shock. No subsidy legislation currently moving. High confidence in continued decline.

Below-normal hurricane season (CSU Apr 2026: El Nino dominant). Very high confidence through Q4 barring tail event.

column3: Medical debt will contribute to rising consumer bankruptcy filings in 2026, with total bankruptcy filings exceeding 600K (up from 517K in 2024) as ACA cliff removes coverage for 1M+ consumers
column9: Medical debt forgiveness at scale OR federal credit reporting protection restored
column10: 2024: 517K filings (+14.2% from 2023). CFPB rule vacated = no protection. ACA cliff removes 1.2M from coverage. Directionally clear; magnitude uncertain.

column10: Farmers pledged 5,600 policies over 2 years. CSAA, Mercury seeking rate increases. But exit momentum is structural. $4B loss from single event = actuarially very difficult to price viably. Regulatory risk remains.
